nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative modeling based on warped Bayesian linear regression.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We utilise the Warped Bayesian Linear Regression normative model [ 3 ] as a basis for our work.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Structural MRI-derived cortical thickness and subcortical volumes were modeled in the pre-trained normative models.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Specifically, cortical thickness and subcortical volumes were modelled, and the models were validated against a subset of 24,000 participants, the quality of which were was checked manually [ 10 ].
nm2_2_response_variable.location: RehakBuckova2025.pdf.md: 2.1.1 Original model for cross-sectional data

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Normative model covariates include age, sex, and scanning site.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: This framework models each image-derived phenotype (IDP) (e.g., voxel intensity, regional thickness, or regional volume) independently as a function of demographic or clinical variables (e.g., age, sex, scanning site) in a large healthy population.
